proves.claim: With spec.requireFactQuote on, pullboard spec verify accepted on a source-backed row with a quote refuses FACT_QUOTE_UNCITED unless the reason contains the quote; with the setting off, or for a rejected verdict, the verification records as before.

cli.journeys-spec-main.verify-accept-cit.why: Without it, a verifier could accept a fact without reading the words it rests on, and nothing would notice.
